title: Canyon Runner
tagline: Chain the boost pads. Kiss the red rock. Beat the sunset clock.
pitch: Canyon Runner: a desert canyon hover-bike time trial. Rip through red-rock canyons at sunset on a hover-bike, chaining boost pads and hitting every checkpoint before the clock runs out. Warm orange stone, long shadows, dust trails, speed lines.

plan.title: Canyon Runner
plan.tagline: Chain the boost pads. Kiss the red rock. Beat the sunset clock.
plan.core_loop: Throttle through the red-rock canyon, line up boost pads and clip every checkpoint to complete 2 laps before the clock hits zero — Embers scattered on the racing line are bonus spice for a better medal.
plan.win_condition: Complete 2 laps before the timer runs out — faster finish times earn better medals.
plan.lose_condition: The clock hits 0:00 before the final lap is complete.
plan.art_direction: Stylized red-sandstone canyon at golden hour: layered rust, amber and cream mesas under a molten orange-to-violet sky, low sun raking long shadows across the racing line. Toon-shaded warm palette with a teal robot rider as the one complementary pop against the stone. Mood: dusty, fast, cinematic — a sunset desert drive with heat shimmer and drifting dust.
concept_shots: Teal robot pilot carving a switchback on the hover-bike, a long amber dust trail streaming behind, speed lines streaking the frame as the low sun rakes the red-rock walls.
The bike blasts across a glowing boost pad mid-canyon, shockwave ring and ember sparks bursting, the road opening into a wide vista with a checkpoint flag waving on a sandstone ledge.
Finish: the bike rockets through the goal arch under a burning orange sky, ember confetti raining as the big TIME banner freezes the clock at 0:07.

assets.sky: Sunset panorama: low amber sun disc sinking between layered red-rock mesas, gradient from molten orange horizon to deep violet zenith, soft pink cirrus, faint dust haze on the horizon.

features: Boost pad chains: rows of boost_pad props on the racing line, each activation fires FX.ring + FX.speedLines + boost SFX
Dust trail: FX.trail behind the kart with FX.dust puffs on hard turns and landings
Wall-scrape juice: FX.hitFlash + FX.shake + scrape SFX when the kart clips canyon walls
Checkpoint flags: flag props at each checkpoint with FX.ring, a toast banner, and the checkpoint chime
Finish slow-mo: FX.slowmo + FX.confetti + big TIME banner on the final lap
Hover hum: soft Audio 'hover' loop under the kart, pitch rising into boosts
plan.mapping_notes: Hover-bike → kart: the kit's closest vehicle controller (kart/boat are the only vehicles), which also brings the chase camera and vehicle physics group the pitch needs. Time trial → mode timetrial (laps vs the clock, medals): 2 laps, 0 opponents, 150s timer, goal portal as the finish. Red-rock canyon → level_kind 'canyon', a whole dressed level with route, checkpoints and goal placements. Sunset fantasy → look 'sunset' (warm orange grade, low sun, long shadows) rather than 'desert', which reads midday. Dust trails and speed lines → FX.trail, FX.dust, FX.speedLines. Boost pads → boost_pad props + the 'boost' hazard. Hover feel → the built-in 'hover' audio loop. The anonymous hover-bike pilot becomes a chibi robot with a fluttering scarf (closest techy species), teal body chosen as a complementary pop against the orange stone. No enemies: the pitch is a pure speed run, so the timer is the only pressure.

result.summary: Canyon Runner: a sunset red-rock canyon hover-kart time trial. Built on the scaffold: switched the level to the 'canyon' kind (winding sandstone loop with arches, hoodoos, boost pads, jump ramps), kept the generated sunset sky, totem/cactus props and splat landmarks, and the sleek HUD with ember counter, timer, lap, minimap and speedometer. The teal robot rider with a scarf drives a teal kart with orange accents. Time trial rules: 2 laps vs a 150s clock, 12-Ember collect target, goal portal, medal targets. Added plan juice: amber dust trail behind the kart, dust puffs on hard turns, boost rings + speed lines + boost SFX on boost pads, checkpoint chime, wall-scrape hit SFX, win slow-mo + ember confetti + win SFX, lose SFX, and a soft WebAudio hover hum that pitches up into boosts. Music (music_main) plays via Audio.music and the generated SFX are preloaded. Title screen sells the fantasy with the tagline and controls credit, 3-2-1-GO countdown. Autopilot verified: moves along the route, collects embers, completes laps with zero console errors.
changes: Level.build switched from race_track to canyon (medium, seed 7, 24 collectibles)

HUD: sleek style, ember counter with generated icon, timer, lap, minimap, speedometer (km/h), objective line; dropped position (no opponents)

Boost event: ring + speedLines + sfx_boost + hover-hum pitch rise
Collect/checkpoint/damage events wired to generated SFX
